subject: gk
question: Copacabana beach is situated in __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brazil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Copacabana** is a neighborhood situated in the South Zone of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
 
• Renowned for its picturesque 4 km (2.5 miles) balneario beach, it stands as one of the most iconic beach destinations globally.
 
• Copacabana boasts the 12th highest Human Development Index (HDI) in Rio, with the HDI recorded at 0.902 in the 2000 census.
 
• According to data from the IBGE, approximately 160,000 residents call Copacabana home, with 44,000 individuals, constituting 27.5% of the population, aged 60 years or older.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Brazil**, officially known as the Federative Republic of Brazil, stands as the largest and easternmost country in South America and Latin America.
 
• With a vast territorial expanse, Brazil ranks as the world's fifth-largest country by area and the seventh most populous.
 
• Its capital city is Brasília, while São Paulo holds the distinction of being its most populous urban center. Brazil operates as a federation comprising the union of 26 states and the Federal District.
 
• It holds the unique distinction of being the sole country in the Americas to adopt Portuguese as its official language.
 
• Renowned for its rich cultural diversity, Brazil stands as one of the most multicultural and ethnically diverse nations globally, shaped by over a century of significant immigration from various corners of the world. Additionally, Brazil holds the distinction of being the most populous Roman Catholic-majority country.
